access.description: Grafana access mode. Provision Pyroscope with proxy access. Queries use the backend HTTP client.

basicAuth.description: Send HTTP Basic credentials to Pyroscope. Omit for anonymous access, forwarded OAuth or header-only authentication.

basicAuthUser.description: HTTP Basic username. For Grafana Cloud Profiles, use the numeric instance ID.

dialTimeout.description: Timeout in whole seconds for establishing an HTTP connection. Zero disables the dial timeout.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route the Pyroscope connection through Private Data Source Connect. Grafana displays the switch when the secure SOCKS proxy is enabled for the instance.

httpExpectContinueTimeout.description: Wait in whole seconds for an HTTP 100 Continue response.

httpHeaders.description: Headers sent with requests to Pyroscope. Store consecutive names in jsonData.httpHeaderName1, httpHeaderName2 and so on, and their values in secureJsonData.httpHeaderValue1, httpHeaderValue2 and so on.

httpIdleConnTimeout.description: Maximum whole seconds an HTTP connection can remain idle.

httpKeepAlive.description: TCP keep-alive interval in whole seconds for HTTP connections. A negative value disables TCP keep-alives.

httpMaxConnsPerHost.description: Maximum total connections per host. Zero allows unlimited connections.

httpMaxIdleConns.description: Maximum idle connections across all hosts. Zero allows unlimited idle connections.

httpMaxIdleConnsPerHost.description: Maximum idle connections per host. Zero uses the HTTP transport default.

httpTLSHandshakeTimeout.description: Timeout in whole seconds for the TLS handshake. Zero disables the handshake timeout.

keepAlive.description: TCP keep-alive interval in whole seconds for the SOCKS proxy. A negative value disables TCP keep-alives.

keepCookies.description: Cookie names Grafana may forward to Pyroscope. Omit to forward no user cookies.

minStep.description: Minimum time step for metric and heatmap queries and for normalizing cumulative profile values. The editor accepts a whole number and one unit (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M or y). Provisioning also accepts Go durations such as 1m30s. Empty or invalid input uses 15s.

oauthPassThru.description: Forward the signed-in user’s OAuth access token and available ID token to Pyroscope. Set jsonData.oauthPassThru to true for this mode. No stored token is needed.

secureSocksProxyUsername.description: Grafana Cloud loads the stack’s PDC private networks and stores the selected network ID as the proxy username. For a self-managed SOCKS proxy, use its username. The SDK defaults to the data source UID when this field is absent.

serverName.description: DNS name used for TLS SNI and certificate verification. The editor requests it with TLS client authentication. Provisioning can omit it to use the URL hostname, or supply it with a private CA.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in whole seconds. With PDC it also sets the SOCKS connection timeout. Zero disables the HTTP request timeout.

tlsAuth.description: Authenticate to Pyroscope with the client certificate and matching private key.

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Use a private CA trust bundle to verify the server certificate.

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skip verification of the Pyroscope server certificate and hostname.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS endpoint of Pyroscope or its gateway.

user.description: Legacy HTTP Basic username read by the SDK when basicAuth is false. Use basicAuthUser for new Basic-authenticated connections.

withCredentials.description: Legacy flag for cross-site browser credentials. An existing value can make the editor show an unavailable auth mode. Selecting a current mode clears it. Pyroscope sends requests from the backend.

secureValues.description: HTTP Basic password. For Grafana Cloud Profiles, store an access policy token with profiles:read scope in secureJsonData.basicAuthPassword.
PEM trust bundle for the Pyroscope endpoint. When supplied, this bundle replaces the system roots for this connection.
PEM client certificate presented to Pyroscope for mutual TLS.
PEM private key paired with the client certificate.
Password for a SOCKS proxy that requires authentication. A Grafana Cloud PDC agent network needs only the selected network ID.
Password for the legacy root user field. New Basic-authenticated connections use secureJsonData.basicAuthPassword.
